_comment: What this server declares about itself: the files it reads (library_types), the Results/ folders the bridge writes (result_types, created at startup), parameters a workflow may leave out, and that RunMeasurement measures a plate and returns AnIML. See v1/src/catalog.py.

value_labels.usb: usb - stored connection, then a fresh scan (unattended-safe)
value_labels.ask: ask - as above, then the picker if still not found (needs someone at the PC)
value_labels.dialog: dialog - the picker, straight away (needs someone at the PC)
value_labels.any: any - USB or simulator, whichever answers

result_types.description: Written when the bridge's GenerateExcel is on
ASTM E1947 analytical data, linked to plates

resources._comment: tray:tecan is the plate tray as a space, occupied while something moves in it: PlateIn, PlateOut, a measurement, and the mobile robot's place_on_TC / pick_from_tecan tasks. slot:tecan is 'a plate is in the reader', a state that outlives any one step: the robot acquires it when it places a plate and releases it when it picks the plate up. It is NOT held by PlateIn - PlateIn only moves the tray, and is called both to load a plate and to close the empty tray afterwards. There is no emergency_stop here because this server has no stop command: an emergency stop reports the reader as not stopped. See v1/docs/RESOURCE_MODEL.md.
